entries.title: Psalms 102:1
segments: ¶<A Prayer of the man who is in trouble, when he is overcome, and puts his grief before the Lord.> Give ear to my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come to you.

entries.title: Psalms 102:2
segments: Let not your face be veiled from me in the day of my trouble; give ear to me, and let my cry be answered quickly.

entries.title: Psalms 102:3
segments: My days are wasted like smoke, and my bones are burned up as in a fire.

entries.title: Psalms 102:4
segments: My heart is broken; it has become dry and dead like grass, so that I give no thought to food.

entries.title: Psalms 102:5
segments: Because of the voice of my sorrow, my flesh is wasted to the bone.

entries.title: Psalms 102:6
segments: I am like a bird living by itself in the waste places; like the night-bird in a waste of sand.

entries.title: Psalms 102:7
segments: I keep watch like a bird by itself on the house-top.

entries.title: Psalms 102:8
segments: My haters say evil of me all day; those who are violent against me make use of my name as a curse.

entries.title: Psalms 102:9
segments: I have had dust for bread and my drink has been mixed with weeping:

entries.title: Psalms 102:10
segments: Because of your passion and your wrath, for I have been lifted up and then made low by you.

entries.title: Psalms 102:11
segments: My days are like a shade which is stretched out; I am dry like the grass.

entries.title: Psalms 102:12
segments: ¶But you, O Lord, are eternal; and your name will never come to an end.

entries.title: Psalms 102:13
segments: You will again get up and have mercy on Zion: for the time has come for her to be comforted.

entries.title: Psalms 102:14
segments: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, looking with love on her dust.

entries.title: Psalms 102:15
segments: So the nations will give honour to the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth will be in fear of his glory:

entries.title: Psalms 102:16
segments: When the Lord has put up the walls of Zion, and has been been in his glory;

entries.title: Psalms 102:17
segments: When he has given ear to the prayer of the poor, and has not put his request on one side.

entries.title: Psalms 102:18
segments: This will be put in writing for the coming generation, and the people of the future will give praise to the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 102:19
segments: For from his holy place the Lord has seen, looking down on the earth from heaven;

entries.title: Psalms 102:20
segments: Hearing the cry of the prisoner, making free those for whom death is ordered;

entries.title: Psalms 102:21
segments: So that they may give out the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

entries.title: Psalms 102:22
segments: When the peoples are come together, and the kingdoms, to give worship to the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 102:23
segments: ¶He has taken my strength from me in the way; he has made short my days.

entries.title: Psalms 102:24
segments: I will say, O my God, take me not away before my time; your years go on through all generations:

entries.title: Psalms 102:25
segments: In the past you put the earth on its base, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

entries.title: Psalms 102:26
segments: They will come to an end, but you will still go on; they all will become old like a coat, and like a robe they will be changed:

entries.title: Psalms 102:27
segments: But you are the unchanging One, and your years will have no end.

entries.title: Psalms 102:28
segments: The children of your servants will have a safe resting-place, and their seed will be ever before you.
